newsitem.title: RUSSIA: Russia SBS-Agro says Moody's rates it B1, S&P B+.
newsitem.headline: Russia SBS-Agro says Moody's rates it B1, S&P B+.

text.p: One of Russia's biggest banks, SBS-Agro (Stolichny Bank Sberezheny), which plans to issue a dollar Eurobond, said on Wednesday Moody's had awarded it a B1 rating and Standard & Poor's had rated it B+.
"SBS-Agro has become the first Russian bank to get a rating from international rating companies: Moody's B1 and Standard & Poor's B+," the bank said in a statement.
The rating are less than Russia's sovereign rating of Ba2 from Moody's and BB- from S&P.
SBS-Agro, which specialises in retail banking, plans a road-show for its debut Eurobond from June 24 to July 2.
J.P. Morgan Securities will lead-manage the issue.
Several other Russian banks, including Promstroibank St Petersburg, Inkombank and Uneximbank, plan Eurobond issues.
